answer_1.quote: Simultaneous speech translation (SiST) begins translating before the source inputs are fully received.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating monotonic translations in simultaneous speech translation by applying the salami technique via LLMs, particularly in speech-to-text settings.

answer_2.quote: We used four distinct metrics, which were chosen because each evaluates using different criteria: BLEU, BLEURT, COMET, and COMET-QE.
